description:
This project is a music streaming platform unlike Spotify it uses Pay as you Listen model 
users will be charged from minutes listened
Sample scenario
Consider a song of Ariana Grande - 7 Rings
it has 
Spotify-  2.5 billions
YT music - 2.6 billions
apple music - some billions
Youtube - 1.5 billion

Despite being her one 15+ songs her annual earnings is less than 16 million* for her singing career if we don't consider the Shows she act on
So for a famous song she earns around 2 million so we get the value of 0.0002 dollars per listening after including the making cost, patents,directors salary

In conclusion you need to listen to 20000 songs to pay 2$ incorporating platform fees it will be always cheaper than current alternatives

Music listeners are not nerd so the wallet integration payment gateways are make abstract and seamless for easy onboarding
how_its_made:
Tunify is a music streaming platform so it hold a lot of music files, thumbnails, and metadata. All of which are stored in IPFS storage offered by Opsec, I am using more than 2 Gigs of storage on IPFS thanks to Opsec

For easy user onboarding we are using privy's embedded wallets so people without prior web3 knowledge can also use the platform with ease, also the way privy handles non wallets client by integrating Gpay and other Onramping protocol

For all the chain interactions i are using Base network of its L2 robust handling of transactions
I have contributed to Covalent Ai agent sdk to add support for hugging face and Gradio inferences. I have had a very good experience with Covalent in the past. I have raised PR for all the contributions that i have made in the ai-agent-sdk, kindly review it and merge it
No one have tried using audio or other models on Covalent . The gradio and HF integration has made it easy to use high performance hosted models in any project


I have tried to use EigenLayer for rest of the interaction of backend and the contract
